headlines.text: It was 2021 when Darby Allin vs. John Silver fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.35 ? a good, competitive contest. It was the first title opportunity of John Silver's career. This stood as the 20th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a notable milestone for the title. A tribute match, with Allin honoring the late Brodie Lee by opening his title to The Dark Order ? Silver even paid homage to his fallen leader by attempting his signature powerbomb, but Allin countered for the win, sharing a respectful fist bump with Silver afterward.
On a Friday in 2023, back when Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Penta El Zero M clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.53. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
2021 brought us this moment: Young Bucks & Cutler kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.35 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when Varsity Blonds & Dante stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.05.
